description: This file implements a helper package for executing 'go' commands, managing concurrency, handling errors, and writing overlays for unsaved buffers.

classes.name: Runner
classes.description: A struct that manages execution of 'go' commands with concurrency control.

classes.name: Invocation
classes.description: A struct representing a specific invocation of the 'go' command with parameters.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Runner's channels for concurrency control.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes a 'go' command invocation and returns stdout and a friendly error.

methods.name: RunPiped
methods.description: Runs a 'go' command serially, waiting for other invocations to complete.

methods.name: RunRaw
methods.description: Runs the invocation, serializing requests if they conflict over go.mod changes.

methods.name: runConcurrent
methods.description: Executes the command concurrently, respecting concurrency limits.

methods.name: runPiped
methods.description: Executes the command serially with output piped to provided writers.

methods.name: runWithFriendlyError
methods.description: Runs the command and returns a friendly error message if it fails.

methods.name: logf
methods.description: Logs messages if a logging function is set.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Constructs and executes the 'go' command with appropriate arguments.
